content_sections.heading: TNJFU Professor of Practice (PoP) Job Description
content_sections.text: Active involvement in developing, updating and designing industry-aligned courses and curricula. Mentoring and encouraging students in innovation, technology transfer and entrepreneurship. Strengthening industry-academia collaborations, joint research ventures, and field level applications.

faq.question: Q1. How many Professor of Practice posts has TNJFU announced?
faq.answer: TNJFU has announced 3 Professor of Practice (PoP) posts in Fisheries & Aquaculture at its Constituent Fisheries Colleges, Nagapattinam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNJFU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Registrar on or before 05:00 PM on 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is an academic qualification required for TNJFU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: A formal academic qualification is not considered essential if the candidate has exemplary professional practice. A minimum of 15 years of proven professional experience/service in the Fisheries & Aquaculture Industry is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for TNJFU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 2000/- per lecture (or) Rs.40,000/- per month (Max.). The consolidated pay will be fixed as per the norms.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for TNJFU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: Send your resume with copies of relevant documents by post to The Registrar, Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University, Vettar River View Campus, Nagapattinam – 611 002, to reach by 05:00 PM on 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the tenure of the TNJFU Professor of Practice post?
faq.answer: The initial engagement is for 1 year, extendable up to a maximum period of 3 years based on performance review.

faq.question: Q7. Is the TNJFU Professor of Practice post honorary or regular?
faq.answer: The post is on an honorary basis with lecture-based remuneration, not regular faculty recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. Are publication requirements applicable to TNJFU Professor of Practice?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are exempt from the publication and other eligibility criteria required for regular faculty recruitment at the Professor level, but must have the skills to fulfil the specified duties.
